item.title: NFC Contender hires ex-Bears coach Matt Eberflus as defensive assistant
item.description: Matt Eberflus is back in the NFL as a defensive coach.This time, the former Chicago Bears head coach will partner up with an NFC contender, according to reports.The San Francisco 49ers have reportedly hired Eberflus as their assistant head coach of defense, Tom Pelissero reported on Thursday.Eberflus will fill the role in San Francisco vacated by Gus Bradley, who left to be the defensive coordinator for the Titans. item.description: Tenants at Chaney Braggs Apartments, at 65th Street and Stony Island Avenue, held a rally Thursday morning, protesting possible rent increases and the threat of losing their homes as construction continues at the Obama Presidential Center a few blocks away.Residents say a California investor wants to buy the building and either gut and rehab it or demolish it. item.description: On Chicago’s South Side, the sound of clippers and conversation has long been part of the culture. item.description: The artificial intelligence landscape is evolving rapidly, and it's not just changing the workplace, it's also reshaping how kids learn.Schools are now grappling with how — and whether — to incorporate the technology into the classroom. Integrating AI into education is raising questions about accuracy, privacy, and traditional learning. item.title: Chicago Bears are releasing LB Tremaine Edmunds after seeking a trade
item.description: The Chicago Bears are releasing a starting linebacker after trying to find a trade partner.According to reports, the Bears are releasing Tremaine Edmunds before free agency starts next week.ESPN reported Thursday evening that the Bears are releasing Edmunds. item.title: Chicago weather: Dense fog tonight, strong storms possible tomorrow
item.description: A Dense Fog Advisory will remain in effect for Lake County and Cook County in Northeast Illinois until 6 AM Friday.
